description: Enlarged and cut 35mm contact sheet with film strip numbers 4, 5, and 6, depicting rockface formations and foliage along the Colorado River. Todd Webb printed most of O'Keeffe's contact sheets and photographic prints. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe "In memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River."
title: Glen Canyon, contact sheet
